Our Ethical Commitment

Building AI that benefits humanity

At Techodite, we believe that AI and cybersecurity research must be conducted with the highest ethical standards. Our ethical framework guides every aspect of our research, from initial conception to deployment and beyond.

"Technology should empower humanity, not diminish it. AI must be developed with compassion, foresight, and respect for human dignity."

Responsible Team

Ethics Review Process

1
2 weeks

Research Proposal

Initial ethics screening of research objectives and methods

Requirements:

  • • Ethics checklist
  • • Data management plan
  • • Risk assessment
2
4 weeks

Ethics Committee Review

Comprehensive review by multidisciplinary ethics committee

Requirements:

  • • Detailed protocol
  • • Participant safeguards
  • • Mitigation strategies
3
Project duration

Approval & Monitoring

Ongoing monitoring throughout research lifecycle

Requirements:

  • • Regular progress reports
  • • Incident reporting
  • • Final audit
4
2 weeks

Post-Research Review

Assessment of ethical outcomes and lessons learned

Requirements:

  • • Outcomes report
  • • Impact assessment
  • • Knowledge sharing

Prohibited Research Areas

Autonomous Weapons

AI systems designed for autonomous lethal force

Violates principles of human dignity and control

Social Scoring Systems

AI for mass surveillance and social control

Undermines democratic values and individual freedoms

Manipulative AI

AI designed to exploit psychological vulnerabilities

Violates autonomy and informed consent principles

Genetic Discrimination AI

AI for genetic profiling and discrimination

Violates principles of equality and non-discrimination
